name: [🌋UPD 2] Steal a football team
desc:
Build your ultimate football team… by stealing it! ⚽💥
In Steal a Football Team you infiltrate enemy bases, dodge deadly lasers, and snatch their best players before they reach safety. Protect your base, upgrade your defenses, and take part in epic global events like the Champions Event to earn huge rewards.

🏆 Key Features

Steal players from other teams in real time

Protect your base with lasers and traps

Epic events with global boosts

Customize and expand your football empire

Compete to become the #1 team owner

Can you steal your way to the top?
